backup.production_rule: Usage learning (spec docs/s118/SPEC-usage-learning.md). inventory_items gains usage_baseline_per_turnover, usage_baseline_note, usage_state (baseline|learning|measured), last_refill_at, last_refill_qty, usage_updated_at. New table public.inventory_usage_intervals (RLS on, no grant to any API role). Internal, no grants: record_inventory_anchor_v1, s_inventory_usage_recompute_v1, inventory_usage_quarterly_reset_v1 (pg_cron inventory-usage-quarterly-reset, 1 Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct 20:00 UTC). get_inventory_usage_kpi_v1: authenticated, gate read_operations. Hooks (one block each, any error becomes a WARNING): s_apply_inventory_count_core_v1 (md5 3937a6da154fe1ed60471689833f96e2), record_inventory_receipt_v1 (7cb59453f37eeeeb15b1e9f4c4ffa883), apply_inventory_purchase (48082c76263e15517d733c65f7eb3ccc), s_inventory_receipt_apply_v1 (4f09a8ae895d945703f60a96705413e7). get_inventory_catalogue_v1 (00ca41d933a5c5a9c4498cff682e7844) gains six keys. The migration seeds 22 baselines and sets consumption_per_booking where it was the 2.00 default or null, then replays the 27 Oct and 18 Nov telegram_count audit rows through the anchor (expected: 3 accepted intervals - Laundry, Hand Soap, Insect Spray; Coffee rejected as unrecorded restock).
backup.notes: Additive. No signature, grant or existing result key changes; five function bodies are cut by patching the live body after an md5 guard (55000 when production moved). Writes: the new columns and table, consumption_per_booking and usage_state on the seeded items. Stock, purchases and the audit log are not written. consumption_per_booking is read by daily-digest (runway) and telegram-expense (short when qty < rate): real rates make both quieter than 2.00 did. Deploy order: SQL only; apps may read the new catalogue keys and the KPI RPC afterwards.

rollback.safe_until: Always, with data loss by design: every interval, learned rate, seeded baseline and refill mark is dropped, and consumption_per_booking returns to 2.00 (null for All-Purpose Cleaner, Bathroom tissue, Kitchen towel and Tough Grease). The script takes the hook block back out of the four functions and the six keys out of the catalogue, with an md5 guard on each body, before it drops anything.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261120_s120_usage_learning.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh; then md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) must be 3937a6da154fe1ed60471689833f96e2 (s_apply_inventory_count_core_v1), 7cb59453f37eeeeb15b1e9f4c4ffa883 (record_inventory_receipt_v1), 48082c76263e15517d733c65f7eb3ccc (apply_inventory_purchase), 4f09a8ae895d945703f60a96705413e7 (s_inventory_receipt_apply_v1) and 00ca41d933a5c5a9c4498cff682e7844 (get_inventory_catalogue_v1), and public.inventory_usage_intervals must not exist. Roll back any app that reads usageState or get_inventory_usage_kpi_v1 first.
